main_measure.name: OLS slope of 10-bar forward return minus coin mean 10-bar return on forecast (non-overlapping grid, non-zero forecast, pooled)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting check passed; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean directional excess return, top third of |forecast| minus bottom third

decided_by: The slope is positive with t >= 2 and the top third of |forecast| earns more in its direction than the bottom third.
reading: The situation is the regime column equal to the profile regime 'unknown' (rising calm, not vetoed) with the forecast's sign equal to the sign of the raw range position; the slope is an OLS fit with intercept and a day-clustered standard error (G/(G-1) correction); the coin's mean 10-bar return is taken on the non-overlapping grid of all its windows; thirds of |forecast| are equal-count splits of the cases sorted by |forecast|; the plan's minimum of 100 cases, if not reached, gives 'not observable'.

direction_check.why: no check fold (the plan has none, or the backtest did not run on its folds)
